units.source_text: 我大致讲了这些：作为秀哉名人告别赛的对手，大竹七段是凭自己的力量进行弈战的。

en.t: I spoke roughly as follows: as the opponent in Master Shusai's farewell game, Otake 7-dan fought the match by his own strength.

units.source_text: 然而，这不是大竹个人在战斗，而是作为另一个新时代的选手、继承历史进程的代表在同名人对棋。

en.t: Yet this was not Otake fighting as a private individual; he was playing against the Master as a player of another new age, a representative inheriting the course of history.

units.source_text: 在选出大竹七段之前，曾举办了历时一年的“向名人告别赛挑战的决战”。

en.t: Before Otake 7-dan was chosen, a year-long decisive contest was held to determine who would challenge the Master in his farewell game.

units.source_text: 首先是在六段级进行，久保松、前田获得优胜。

en.t: First it was held at the 6-dan level, where Kubomatsu and Maeda emerged victorious.

units.source_text: 铃木、濑越、加藤、大竹参加了七段级，举行了六人循环赛。

en.t: Suzuki, Segoe, Kato, and Otake entered the 7-dan class, and a six-person round-robin tournament was held.

units.source_text: 大竹七段全胜。

en.t: Otake 7-dan won every game.

units.source_text: 铃木和久保松两位恩师也都败在他的手下。

en.t: Even his two revered teachers, Suzuki and Kubomatsu, were defeated by him.

units.source_text: 铃木七段在风华正茂之年，本想借定先战胜名人，以弥补互先时的胜负各判，

en.t: Suzuki 7-dan, in the prime of his powers, had hoped to defeat the Master with a fixed first-move handicap and make up for the divided results when they had played on even terms,

units.source_text: 不料根本没碰上同名人对弈的机会，据说这使铃木遗憾终生。

en.t: but unexpectedly he never had the chance to play the Master at all, and this is said to have remained Suzuki's lifelong regret.

units.source_text: 按理说，大竹应让这两位恩师获得再次同名人对弈的机会，才是尽弟子之情。

en.t: By rights, Otake ought to have let these two teachers have another chance to play the Master; that would have fulfilled his feeling as a disciple.

units.source_text: 然而，大竹七段竟击败铃木七段。

en.t: Yet Otake 7-dan actually defeated Suzuki 7-dan.

units.source_text: 争夺最后胜负的是连获四胜的棋手久保松和大竹这师生二人。

en.t: The final contest was fought between the two players who had won four straight games: Kubomatsu and Otake, teacher and pupil.

units.source_text: 看来也包含这样的意思：大竹七段是作为两位恩师的替身与名人对弈的。

en.t: It seems to have carried this meaning as well: Otake 7-dan was playing the Master as the stand-in for his two teachers.

units.source_text: 比起铃木、久保松这些元老来，年轻的七段的确是现今的棋手代表。

en.t: Compared with elders such as Suzuki and Kubomatsu, the young 7-dan was indeed the representative of the present generation of players.

units.source_text: 大竹七段的知交和棋敌吴清源六段，也可能成为并列的代表。

en.t: Otake 7-dan's friend and rival, Go Seigen 6-dan, might also have stood beside him as such a representative.

units.source_text: 可是，他五年前同名人对局时采用新布局，输了。

en.t: However, when he played the Master five years earlier, he used the new fuseki and lost.

units.source_text: 假使吴清源也获得了选手权，但他当时还是五段，

en.t: Even if Go Seigen had gained the right to be the challenger, he was still only 5-dan at the time,

units.source_text: 对名人来说，他并非真正实力相当的对手，也就算不上是名人的告别赛了。

en.t: and for the Master he was not truly an opponent of equal strength, so it could not really have counted as the Master's farewell game.

units.source_text: 这之前，名人的胜负棋远溯十二三年前，对手是雁金七段。

en.t: Before this, the Master's last serious match went back twelve or thirteen years, when his opponent was Karigane 7-dan.

units.source_text: 那时是日本棋院同棋正社的对抗赛，雁金七段是名人的宿敌，老早以前就是名人的手下败将。

en.t: At that time it was a match between the Nihon Ki-in and the Kiseisha; Karigane 7-dan was the Master's old rival, but long before then he had already been defeated by the Master.

units.source_text: 名人当然又胜了。

en.t: Naturally, the Master won again.

units.source_text: 于是“常胜名人”最后的胜负棋，就是这盘告别棋了。

en.t: Thus the final serious match of the ever-victorious Master became this farewell game.

units.source_text: 这次同雁金七段和吴清源六段的对弈意义不同。

en.t: This game had a different significance from the games against Karigane 7-dan and Go Seigen 6-dan.

units.source_text: 纵令大竹七段战胜名人，也不会立即给下一代名人造成麻烦。

en.t: Even if Otake 7-dan defeated the Master, it would not immediately create trouble for the next Master.

units.source_text: 因为告别赛是时代的转折，也是时代的交接，

en.t: For the farewell game was a turning point of an era and also a handover from one era to the next,

units.source_text: 后来人将会给棋界带来新的朝气。

en.t: and those who came after would bring new vitality to the go world.

units.source_text: 中断告别赛，就好比阻止了历史的进程。

en.t: To interrupt the farewell game would be like stopping the progress of history.

units.source_text: 大竹七段责任重大，凭个人义气和事由就放弃这盘棋合适吗？

en.t: Otake 7-dan bore a grave responsibility; was it proper for him to abandon this game because of personal loyalty or private circumstances?

units.source_text: 大竹七段要活到名人现在这把岁数，还得有三十五年。

en.t: For Otake 7-dan to live to the age the Master had now reached, he would still need another thirty-five years.

units.source_text: 也就是说这三十五年比他出生后度过的三十年还要多五年。

en.t: In other words, those thirty-five years were five more than the thirty years he had already lived since birth.

units.source_text: 同在围棋昌盛时期由日本棋院培养起来的七段相比，

en.t: Compared with a 7-dan raised by the Nihon Ki-in during a flourishing age of go,

units.source_text: 名人过去所受的苦楚是不同的。

en.t: the hardships the Master had endured in the past were of a different kind.

units.source_text: 总之，从明治的草创期经过勃兴，再到近年的昌盛，

en.t: In short, from the founding days of the Meiji era through its rise and then to the prosperity of recent years,

units.source_text: 名人一直肩负着围棋的重任，是棋界的头号人物。

en.t: the Master had always shouldered the heavy responsibility of go and had been the foremost figure in the go world.

units.source_text: 成全这六十五年生涯的告别赛，难道不是后继者的本分吗？

en.t: Was it not the duty of his successors to bring to completion the farewell game that would round out this sixty-five-year life?

units.source_text: 在箱根，病人虽有些任性，还是强忍着老人的病痛坚持续弈了。

en.t: At Hakone, although the sick man was somewhat willful, he endured the pains of old age and illness and continued the game.

units.source_text: 他虽身体欠佳，还是想在伊东下完这盘棋，甚至还把白发染黑才来。

en.t: Although his health was poor, he still wanted to finish the game at Ito, and he even dyed his white hair black before coming.

units.source_text: 这也是一种拼搏精神。

en.t: This too was a kind of fighting spirit.

units.source_text: 年轻对手却要放弃这盘棋，

en.t: Yet the young opponent wanted to abandon this game,

units.source_text: 社会上都会同情名人，大竹七段就会成为众矢之的。

en.t: and society would sympathize with the Master, while Otake 7-dan would become the target of public criticism.

units.source_text: 即使七段理由正当，也将以争论不休或互相揭短而告终。

en.t: Even if the 7-dan's reasons were justified, it would end in endless argument or mutual fault-finding.

units.source_text: 世人不会知晓事情真相。

en.t: The public would never know the truth of the matter.

units.source_text: 这是具有历史意义的告别赛，

en.t: This was a farewell game of historical significance,

units.source_text: 大竹七段放弃比赛，也将载入围棋的史册。

en.t: and if Otake 7-dan abandoned the match, that too would be recorded in the history of go.

units.source_text: 更重要的是七段肩负着下一个时代的责任。

en.t: More important, the 7-dan bore responsibility for the next era.

units.source_text: 如果他放弃这盘棋，

en.t: If he abandoned this game,

units.source_text: 人们有关终局胜败的揣摩推测，就会成为喧嚣而丑恶的街谈巷议。

en.t: people's guesses and speculations about the final victory or defeat would turn into noisy, ugly street gossip.

units.source_text: 年轻的后来人妨碍病中的老名人的告别赛，这样好吗？

en.t: Would it be right for a young successor to obstruct the farewell game of the old Master in his illness?
